🍊✨ Orange Collagen Jelly Cups | Easy Beauty Recipe

A refreshing, citrusy treat with a little beauty boost! 🧡
Comment down for link 🔗 

Ingredients 🛒

* Fresh oranges (2)
* 1 scoop from @wellbeing.nutrition Pure Korean Marine Collagen Peptides
* 1 tsp lemon juice
* 1–2 tsp maple syrup (adjust to taste)
* 1 tsp agar-agar powder

Recipe 👩🏻‍🍳

1. Cut the oranges in half and scoop out the pulp. Keep the orange peels for serving.
2. Blend the pulp and strain to extract fresh orange juice.
3. Add Wellbeing Nutrition Pure Korean Marine Collagen Peptides and mix well.
4. Add lemon juice, maple syrup and agar-agar powder.
5. Gently heat the mixture, stirring until the agar-agar dissolves completely.
6. Let it cool slightly, pour into the orange peels and refrigerate for 4–5 hours until set.
7. Cut into wedges and enjoy your homemade orange collagen jelly cups! 🍊🧡

✨ Featuring Type I & III collagen peptides, sourced from wild-caught deep-sea Korean fish, with 8 g of collagen peptides per serving.

Save this easy recipe for later! 🤍

2 adet tavuk göğsünü küçük küçük doğrayıp tavada soteleyin. İçlerini hazırladığınız tavuklu harçla doldurun. Sırasıyla 1 su bardağı una, 2 adet çırpılmış yumurtaya ve 1 su bardağı galeta ununa bulayın. Kızgın sıvı yağda altın rengini alana kadar kızartın. Yağın iyice kızgın olması yağ çekmesini önler; külahların açılmaması için uçlarını iyice yapıştırın.

Creamy Chicken Crispy Lavash Cones

Sauté 2 chicken breasts, finely chopped, in a pan. Add 1 chopped onion, 1 green pepper, and 1 red pepper, and continue cooking. Add 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon dried mint, 1 teaspoon paprika, and 1 teaspoon thyme. Finally, add 1 pack (200 ml) of cream, mix well, and remove from the heat. Cut 3–4 lavash breads into quarters. Mix 1 tablespoon flour with 2–3 tablespoons water until it forms a paste, then use it to seal the edges of the lavash and shape them into cones. Fill the cones with the creamy chicken mixture. Coat them first in 1 cup flour, then 2 beaten eggs, and finally 1 cup breadcrumbs. Fry in hot vegetable oil until golden and crispy. Make sure the oil is very hot to prevent the cones from absorbing too much oil, and seal the edges well so they don’t open while frying.

🍎 Apple Coffee Cake with Cinnamon Streusel

For the Cake

	•	1 box yellow cake mix
	•	3 large eggs
	•	⅓ cup neutral oil
	•	¾ cup milk
	•	2 medium apples, peeled and diced

For the Cinnamon Streusel

	•	1⅓ cups all-purpose flour
	•	½ cup packed brown sugar
	•	¼ cup granulated sugar
	•	1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
	•	Nutmeg 
	•	½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
	•	Pinch of salt

Optional Vanilla Glaze

	•	½ cup powdered sugar
	•	1–2 tablespoons milk
	•	¼ teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

1. Prepare the Apples

Peel and dice the apples into small pieces. Toss them with 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 tablespoon light brown sugar sugar and Set aside.

2. Make the Streusel

In a bowl, combine the flour, brown sugar, granulated sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Add the melted butter and mix until chunky crumbs form. If the mixture is too soft, refrigerate for 15–20 minutes before using.

Divide the streusel into two portions.

3. Prepare the Cake Batter

Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a baking pan.

In a large bowl, combine the yellow cake mix, eggs, oil, and milk. Mix until smooth, following the cake mix instructions for mixing time. 

Spread half the batter evenly into the prepared pan.

4. Layer the Cake

	1.	Sprinkle half the streusel over the cake batter.
	2.	Distribute the cinnamon apples evenly over the streusel.
	3.	Carefully spread the remaining cake batter over the apples.
	4.	Sprinkle the remaining streusel evenly over the top.

5. Bake

Bake at 350°F for approximately 45–65 minutes, beginning to check around 40 minutes. Baking time will vary depending on the cake mix and oven.

Insert a toothpick into the cake portion, avoiding the apple filling. It should come out clean or with a few moist crumbs. If the topping browns too quickly, loosely cover the cake with foil.

6. Make the Glaze

Whisk the powdered sugar and 1 tablespoon milk  until smooth. Add more milk as needed to reach a drizzling consistency.

Allow the cake to cool before drizzling with the glaze. Let it cool further before slicing so the layers can set.

Pull off pieces of the dough and roll them into balls (try and get them equally shaped) dip each piece into the melted butter and then roll in the cinnamon sugar.
Place into a well buttered fluted pan.
Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes (depending on the size of your dough balls)

Pizza Teflon sendiri harus dipastikan benar-benar matang merata jadi ga bau tepung, tapi ga boleh terlalu lama dipanggang juga karena bakal keras. Kamu tinggal atur ketebalan adonan dan api kompor untuk menghasilkan tekstur pizza yang diinginkan. 

Walaupun agak tricky kalau kamu sudah tau cara kontrol api kompor kamu, pizza Teflon ini bakal jadi olahan yang praktis banget. Aku sendiri kali ini ingin buat pizza yang lebih renyah, jadi aku buat adonan lebih tipis dengan cara panggang menggunakan api sedang. Cukup sekitar 8 menit aja masing-masing sisi sudah kecoklatan, tandanya sudah matang. Jadi kalo kamu ingin teksturnya lebih ngeroti buat adonan lebih tebal lalu panggang dengan api kecil dan panggang sedikit waktu panggangnya.
